parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) A sample containing only one radioactive isotope is brought into the laboratory. The half-life of the isotope is 15 hours. The sample is placed near to the radiation detector in this laboratory. The detector is switched on and, after 1.0 minute, a count of 440 is recorded. The sample is left next to the detector and the experiment is repeated 45 hours later. The detector is switched on for 1.0 minute.
